geometry.scope: snapshot structural topology and finite coordinates

evidence.normal_source: Blender imported custom split normals where has_custom_normals=true

target.contract: budget_material.frame_arrays explicit flat target; not arbitrary engine normals

normal_uv.scope: original indexed edges only; no position welding; imported evaluated corner normals
normal_uv.smoothing_groups: not inferred from IDs; imported evaluated normals include membership effects

cage.scope: exclude pairs sharing original vertices; local reversal is relative to low face normal

projection.limits: 16 deterministic interior samples per low triangle; first hit; no continuous/Cycles certificate
projection.coordinates: imported snapshot world coordinates; no normalization or transform reapplied

geometry_protocol.determinant_units: UV squared per original area normalized by mesh.scale squared
geometry_protocol.contact_coordinate_units: normalized atlas UV; exact original identity required
geometry_protocol.shape_weights: original 3D face area / total original 3D face area
geometry_protocol.shape_p95_definition: left weighted quantile at cumulative original area 0.95
geometry_protocol.shape_tail_definition: area-weighted worst 0.05 mass; fractional boundary face
geometry_protocol.intersection_arithmetic: GEOS floating precision; no snapping or area cutoff
geometry_protocol.guarantee_scope: checked finite-precision state; no exact-arithmetic or global bijection proof

geometry.independent_orientation_policy: constant signed chart; declared group orientation enforced

uv_sampling.scope: active UV atlas geometry; not shader/material routing or filter/compression acceptance

views.coordinate_convention: Y-up; front +Z, back -Z, left +X, right -X; orthographic auto-fit
